page.overview:
Who is Catarina Devon?

Catarina Devon, known as the "Crescent Moon Hunter", is one of Ten Titanic Captains of the Blackbeard Pirates, serving as captain of the sixth ship of the fleet. She is regarded as the worst female pirate in history and was one of the most dangerous criminals ever to be imprisoned within Impel Down until she was freed and recruited by Marshall D. Teach.

Due to her actions and role, she is a supporting antagonist in the Marineford Arc, a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc and a major antagonist in the Final Saga.

Devon is an extremely tall, pale-skinned, and well-endowed woman (shown to stand a similar height to her captain, who is 344 cm) with her dark purple hair in a set of girlish pigtails. Her face has wrinkles, a sloping forehead, a long witch-like nose, a devilish grin, and a square jaw.

Before the timeskip, she wore a striped Impel Down uniform with a V-neckline. She also wore a large magenta cape, a blue pearl necklace, and a purple sash around her waist over lavender cargo-pants and black shoes.
